title: Tavas and Nafas
statementMd:
Today Tavas got his test result as an integer score and he wants to share it with his girlfriend, Nafas.

His phone operating system is Tavdroid, and its keyboard doesn't have any digits! He wants to share his score with Nafas via text, so he has no choice but to send this number using words.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2085b3e153de86bf36ca6563685a007437a065a2.png)

He ate coffee mix without water again, so right now he's really messed up and can't think.

Your task is to help him by telling him what to type.

## Input

The first and only line of input contains an integer $*s*$ ($0 ≤ *s* ≤ 99$), Tavas's score.

## Output

In the first and only line of output, print a single string consisting only from English lowercase letters and hyphens ('`-`'). Do not use spaces.

## Note

You can find all you need to know about English numerals in [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_numerals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_numerals) .
statementZhMd:
今天，Tavas 得到了他的考试成绩，这是一个整数，他想把这个成绩告诉他的女朋友 Nafas。

他的手机操作系统是 Tavdroid，而它的键盘上没有任何数字！他想通过短信把自己的成绩告诉 Nafas，因此只能用单词来发送这个数字。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2085b3e153de86bf36ca6563685a007437a065a2.png)

他又一次不加水就喝了咖啡混合饮料，所以现在脑子一团糟，完全无法思考。

你的任务是帮助他，告诉他应该输入什么。

## 输入格式

输入仅包含一行，一个整数 $*s*$（$0 ≤ *s* ≤ 99$），表示 Tavas 的成绩。

## 输出格式

输出仅包含一行，打印一个仅由英文字母小写和连字符（'`-`'）组成的字符串。不要使用空格。

## 说明

关于英语数字，你可以在[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_numerals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_numerals)中找到所需的全部信息。
